what_para1: Salvation is God's gift of new life, offered freely to anyone who places their trust in Jesus Christ. It isn't something we earn by being good enough; it's something we receive by faith, because Jesus already paid the price for us on the cross.
what_para2: Every one of us has fallen short and been separated from God by sin. But God, in His great love, sent His Son Jesus to live a perfect life, die in our place, and rise again — defeating sin and death forever so that we could be reconciled to Him.
what_para3: Salvation begins the moment you turn from your old way of living and believe in your heart that Jesus is Lord. From there, it becomes a lifelong journey of walking with Him, growing in His Word, and living in the freedom He gives.
prayer_text: Lord Jesus, I believe You are the Son of God. I believe You died for my sins and rose again so that I could be made new. Today, I turn away from my old life and turn toward You. Come into my heart, forgive me, and be my Lord and Savior. Thank You for Your grace and for the gift of eternal life. In Jesus' name, Amen.
decision_para: If you just prayed that prayer or have recently decided to follow Jesus, we would love to celebrate with you and walk alongside you. Fill out the form below, or if you'd rather talk it through first, call or email our pastoral team directly.
